observations: The npm trailing --backends override now wins over its default list.
The smoke launches Hermes with its declared `acp` argument.
Hermes edit approvals use toolCall.kind plus rawInput.tool/rawInput.arguments and may use realpath aliases.
Hermes used its own terminal tool while producing the approved file diff; the acceptance claim is scoped file approval plus an independent test, not a claim that no command ran.
Only Hermes was installed on this host; other configured external backends remain fixture-validated rather than live-validated here.
